statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T≤X → H≤X → (X:ℝ)^((7:ℝ)/120+ε) ≤ (H:ℝ) → (((Finset.Icc (X-H) X).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ (Nat.dist p q)^4≤n^3)).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(H:ℝ)/(1+Real.log (X:ℝ))^A

plain_statement.zh: 在每个短目标区间内，对几乎所有偶数同时要求两素数相距不超过 n^(3/4)。
plain_statement.en: Localize both the target interval and the distance between prime summands.

brief.zh: 文献约束目标所在区间。这里叠加随 n 移动的素数窗口，需要把截断误差与区间起点同时控制。
brief.en: Handle a moving summand cutoff as well as the short target interval.
